description: This file defines an interface for building responses and events related to live commands for modifying 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides factory interfaces for creating command responses like 'created' and 'modified' and for generating relevant events such as 'ThingCreated' and 'ThingModified'.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building responses and events for 'ModifyThing' commands, extending the base LiveCommandAnswerBuilder with specific response and event factories.
